# 📚 Docs or angular.io bug report

### Description

<!-- ✍️edit:--> A clear and concise description of the problem...
https://angular.io/guide/dynamic-form

Dynamic form example - `dynamic-form-question` component, has input value - `questions` and it's `type` field is not there - `QuestionBase<any>`. 
From HTML it's rendering 

```
    <input *ngSwitchCase="'textbox'" [formControlName]="question.key"
            [id]="question.key" [type]="question.type">
```
But `type` property is - QuestionTextBox class specific and it throws type check error on IDE.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/19761422/60783886-82064900-a101-11e9-9191-46f5467ea3af.png)

## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction

Just follow example code from angular.io

### What's the affected URL?**
https://angular.io/guide/dynamic-form#question-form-components

### Reproduction Steps**
<!-- If applicable please list the steps to take to reproduce the issue -->
<!-- ✍️edit:-->
- ` @Input() questions: QuestionBase<any>[] = [];`
- `<input *ngSwitchCase="'textbox'" [formControlName]="question.key"
            [id]="question.key" [type]="question.type">`

### Expected vs Actual Behavior**
<!-- If applicable please describe the difference between the expected and actual behavior after following the repro steps. -->
<!-- ✍️edit:-->

`type` rendering on HTML should pass without any error
